title: Review and Analyze Current README.md
description: Thoroughly review the existing README.md to identify verbose, outdated, or unclear sections and gather all necessary project details for concise documentation.
details: Read through the current README.md file. Note sections that are redundant, unclear, or overly verbose. Cross-reference setup instructions, tech stack, and feature descriptions with the current state of the repository to ensure accuracy. Prepare a list of essential content to retain and areas to improve for clarity and conciseness.
test_strategy: Ensure all critical project information is captured for the rewrite. Confirm that no essential setup or usage details are omitted in the analysis phase.

title: Rewrite and Restructure README.md for Conciseness
description: Edit the README.md to provide a clear, concise overview of the project, its features, tech stack, and setup instructions, following best practices for open-source documentation.
details: Restructure the README.md using clear headings: Project Title, Short Description, Key Features, Tech Stack, and Getting Started. Rewrite verbose sections for brevity and clarity. Ensure the 'Getting Started' section is a simple, numbered list of commands for cloning, installing dependencies, setting up environment variables, and running the dev server. Use markdown formatting (code blocks, lists, bold text) for readability. Remove redundant or outdated information.
test_strategy: Visually inspect the new README.md for clarity, completeness, and formatting. Confirm that all essential sections are present and concise.

title: Verify and Update Setup Instructions
description: Manually validate the setup instructions in the rewritten README.md to ensure they are accurate and complete.
details: Perform a fresh clone of the repository in a new directory. Follow the 'Getting Started' steps exactly as written: install dependencies, configure environment variables, and start the development server. Update the README.md if any steps are missing, unclear, or incorrect.
test_strategy: The local development environment should start successfully by following the README instructions. Any issues encountered should be addressed and the documentation updated accordingly.

title: Proofread and Finalize README.md
description: Proofread the updated README.md for grammar, spelling, and formatting. Ensure it is developer-friendly and ready for new contributors.
details: Check the README.md for typos, grammatical errors, and markdown formatting issues. Ensure language is clear and instructions are easy to follow. Confirm that the document meets professional standards and is accessible to developers unfamiliar with the project.
test_strategy: No errors or ambiguities should remain. The README.md should be ready for immediate use by new contributors.
